from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote

ASSET_ROOT = Path("/srv/synthetic/assets")


def open_asset(asset):
    decoded = unquote(asset)
    candidate = ASSET_ROOT / decoded
    return candidate.read_bytes()
